notes: In the Great Walks season you can walk this track in one direction only: Glade Wharf to Sandfly Point.
You must stay at Clinton Hut, Mintaro Hut and Dumpling Hut in this sequence. Camping is not permitted.
Heavy rain can flood the track. Do what the hut wardens tell you.
Mackinnon Pass is open to wind and cold. Carry warm and waterproof clothes on that day.
Sandflies are bad at Sandfly Point. Use repellent.

mintaro.name: Mintaro Hut
mintaro.note: DOC hut. You must book before you go. Facilities: cooking, heating, mattresses, lighting, flush toilets. Boil the water before you drink it. It is 250 m from the track line on this map.

start.name: Glade Wharf
start.note: The boat from Te Anau Downs comes in here. The boat trip is about 1 hour 15 minutes.

end.name: Sandfly Point
end.note: End of the track. The boat to Milford Sound leaves from here. Book it before you go.

pois.name: Sutherland Falls
pois.text: One of the highest waterfalls in New Zealand: 580 m in three steps. The side track from Quintin Shelter takes about 1 hour 30 minutes there and back.

pois.name: Giant Gate Falls
pois.text: Waterfall beside a swing bridge. A good place for lunch on the last day.

pois.name: Mackay Falls
pois.text: Waterfall beside the track. Bell Rock is next to it: you can go inside the hollow rock.

pois.name: Lake Ada
pois.text: A landslide made this lake about 900 years ago. The track follows its shore to Sandfly Point.

pois.name: Mackinnon Pass
pois.text: The highest point of the track, 1154 m. A memorial to the explorer Quintin McKinnon is near the top. A day shelter is a short distance on.
